steps.speaker: News
steps.content: Recently, several key figures in Eastside have received anonymous threat letters, and attacks have been happening.

steps.speaker: News
steps.content: The incidents occurred just as the situation in the West District was getting under control, making the timing of these events quite intriguing. Although there have been no fatalities so far, inside sources reveal that these series of incidents are closely linked to the serial assassination incidents from three weeks ago.

steps.speaker: News
steps.content: If the mastermind behind these incidents isn't caught soon, the number of cases of harm could escalate, having a detrimental impact on society.

16:00, August 8, N.F. 113
Eastside Central Park, Bloom Courtyard
"Sunken Blossom" crime scene

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: These are sensitive times. If this scene gets captured by the press and gets out, not only will the public opinion explode, but it'll also cause panic among the people, and...

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Unlike the previous attacks, the scene has been meticulously arranged with no intent to hide the motive—this isn't a covert assassination, but an overtly flaunted ritual.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Hmph, what a show-off, you've caught my attention.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: According to <size=25><color=#7683a2>Shalom's</color></size> inside information, these series of incidents are the work of a Sinner, and there's a high chance that the scene is contaminated with <color=#fb9259>Mania</color>. Everyone, please step back!
Everyone is taken aback, and those near the scene have already retreated out of fear.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Although Sinner incidents are under MBCC jurisdiction, they've been under a lot of pressure recently, and their Chief is missing. Until he returns, I'll take over. I've studied their case files thoroughly.
steps.female_content: Although Sinner incidents are under MBCC jurisdiction, they've been under a lot of pressure recently, and their Chief is missing. Until she returns, I'll take over. I've studied their case files thoroughly.

steps.content: She pulls at her gloves with a serious expression.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Detective Christina will definitely overcome the danger and bring the truth to light!
